item.title: Final Rule to Ban Junk Fees on Hotel Stays in New York — But…
item.description: A final rule was issued from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection of the city of New York to ban hidden mandatory junk fees from being charged to consumers and guest on stays at hotel properties within the city and beyond effective as of Saturday, February 21, 2026. The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection reportedly received hundreds of complaints from consumers related to hidden fees or unexpected holds for stays at hotel properties within the city.
